This article is a stub. Pentair is an American water-equipment company that acquired Essef, and
with it [Paragon Aquatics](paragon-aquatics.md), in August 1999, and that still sells Paragon
starting platforms.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
